name: Uncrowded funding + ADX trend — ride trends NOT built on leverage froth (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why funding leads durability): a trend carried on hot positive funding is a crowded, over-leveraged move that unwinds violently on the first wobble (funding is the revealed cost the crowd is paying to chase). A trend where funding stays LOW/uncrowded is powered by spot demand, not borrowed conviction, and historically persists longer with shallower drawdowns. Funding — a forward-looking carry print — flags the crowding regime BEFORE the eventual leverage-unwind shows up in price. So we require funding_rate below a fitted ceiling (leverage not frothy) AND adx above a floor (a real trend, not chop), and ride it, exiting when ADX collapses (trend dies). Spot long; funding is read point-in-time as a filter, not traded. DISCONFIRMER 1: if dropping the funding ceiling and keeping only the ADX-trend arm matches the deflated Sharpe, funding adds no orthogonal crowding information and this is just ADX trend-follow. DISCONFIRMER 2: if the fit pushes the funding ceiling so high it is always-true, the filter is inert — the edge must come from actually EXCLUDING the frothy-funding trends.
catalyst: funding_rate sits BELOW a fitted 'not-frothy' ceiling (leverage calm) while ADX confirms a real trend.
